Threat model documenting identified threats, attack vectors, and corresponding mitigations mapped to the architecture.
Evidence of Secure by Design principles applied throughout the development lifecycle, not just at architecture review.
Security testing strategy including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and penetration testing with remediation timelines.
Incident response plan with defined roles, communication procedures, and tested runbooks for common security scenarios.
Data protection impact assessment (DPIA) where personal data is processed, with documented lawful basis and safeguards.
Supply chain security assessment for all third-party components, libraries, and services with documented risk acceptance.
